name: Stripe API
tagline: Payment processing API for online payments, subscriptions, and financial infrastructure.
description: Stripe provides a REST API for accepting payments, managing customers, subscriptions, invoices, payouts, and related financial operations. Developers authenticate with secret API keys and can use official SDKs or direct HTTP calls against api.stripe.com.

auth.details: Secret API key via HTTP Basic Auth (key as username, empty password) or Authorization: Bearer sk_...; keys from Dashboard.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No per-request API fee; pay-as-you-go transaction fees (e.g. standard card rates). Test mode free. Exact rates vary by country/product.
pricing.paid_plans: Transaction-based pricing (cards, billing, Connect, etc.); no separate API subscription required for core use.

rate_limits: Global limit: 100 operations/sec in live mode and 25 operations/sec in sandbox; endpoints normally have a 25 operations/sec default, with documented exceptions.
use_cases: create a payment intent for a checkout
list customers or retrieve a customer by id
create a subscription for a price
refund a charge or payment intent
